run_diatomic_curve_test: run a diatomic potential energy curve test for a pretrained MLIP model on omol or omat tasks
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve for two atoms across a range of distances using a predictor model
get_model: load a pretrained MLIP model either from a released checkpoint or a local path for prediction
generate_plot: generate and save a matplotlib plot of a diatomic potential energy curve with distance and relative energy axes
combined_plot: generate a combined matplotlib plot showing multiple diatomic potential energy curves on a single figure
